items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 28 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over the British Isles and deepening areas of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, backing east or southeast 4 or 5 this evening, increasing 5 or 6 overnight and occasionally 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight then mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 6 or 7, veering southerly 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, backing southeast 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, building rough in the west then becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then rain arriving later, becoming heavy for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
